payload.title: Community CUDA Performance Optimization Basics
payload.summary: A compilation of practical knowledge on CUDA programming fundamentals and performance optimization from the Zhihu community. Supplements real-world experience and common pitfalls not covered in GPU Memory Hierarchy and Optimization and GPU Execution Model and Thread Optimization.

sections.heading: 1. Memory Access Optimization
sections.gist: Coalesced access is the most critical aspect of CUDA performance tuning.

sections.heading: 2. Shared Memory Usage Tips
sections.gist: Shared Memory is divided into **32 banks**, each 4 bytes wide.

sections.heading: 3. Occupancy and Resource Balance
sections.gist: Occupancy = Number of active warps per SM / Maximum supported warps per SM.

sections.heading: 4. Warp Execution and Branch Optimization
sections.gist: When 32 threads within the same Warp execute different branch paths, the GPU must serialize execution of each branch (execution cost = sum of all branch costs).

sections.heading: 5. Kernel Launch Overhead and Optimization
sections.gist: For each kernel launch, the CPU must compute execution parameters, maintain pointer addresses, validate Grid/Block dimensions, and push instructions into the GPU hardware queue.
